title: Fade Futuristic Festivities

html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 11 F3 Schwag Bags and Return them to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Fade Futuristic Festivities

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 11 F3 Schwag Bags and Return them to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Do you know what time it is, Dungeon Runner? It is almost time for one of the most spectacularly diabolical events of the calendar year: the Fade Futuristic Festivities! Every year the Fade have a convention where they show off their amazing technology and we've heard that this year they are going to have the event in Vergrim's Vexation. The convention has been a huge show for a long time, but recently they have decided to make it a smaller and more intimately evil affair. The Fade are only inviting a select few creatures which means it is going to be harder for us to get our hands on some of the technology they hand out free to participants. That is where you come in.

The Fade can be found pretty much anywhere in Vergrim's Vexation but the Fade's main area is on levels 3 and 4. Hit them while they are still preparing for the start of F3. I figure if we can strike at them now we can get our hands on some of their high-tech schwag without stirring up too much trouble. You see, once F3 starts and all of the other creatures are there it would be suicide to send you there. Go in, kill the Fade and collect the F3 Schwag Bags that they drop and return to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

I can hardly believe my eyes! You really are something special. Usually I have to dress up as a Whisker Broodling and roll around in Fizz Rock in order to get in and get our hands on the Fade's schwag, but you just waltzed in and took it. Fantastic! Here is a little something for you then.

Objectives:

  • F3 Schwag Bag ×11

Client level range: 25–30
